title: Auto Play Auto Open Crate Auto Collect Time Reward And More
features:
· Auto Play – Plays the table game for you by clicking all required boxes and spots when it’s your turn.
· Auto Claim Time Rewards – Collects every available time reward automatically and tells you how much cash you earned.
· Auto Daily Wheel Spin – Spins the daily wheel and instantly collects your prize. A notification shows what you got.
· Claim Rainbow Chair – Teleports you to the rainbow chair, collects it, and brings you back in one click.
· Select Chair Crate Type – Choose which chair crate you want to keep buying. Each one contains different rare chairs.
· Auto Buy Chair Crate – Keeps buying the selected crate whenever you have enough cash. Alerts you on every purchase.
